title: Customer follow-up reminders
description: Create deterministic commercial follow-up reminders for customers with pending quotes.
constraints: No cron service or background worker is introduced.
Reminder scheduling remains a pure fixture-level calculation.
No external messaging provider is called.
acceptanceCriteria: A pending quote can produce a follow-up reminder candidate.
Reminder rules account for the last contact date.
Dismissed reminders do not reappear immediately.
The system exposes clear empty and overdue states.
Focused tests cover due, not due and dismissed reminder cases.
expectedConflictNotes: Reminder scheduler and UI share due-state semantics.
